description.value:
Frequency once per day

Area 60-foot emanation

Duration 1 minute

The atmosphere around you becomes the weapon. Every creature in the emanation other than you and your allies takes your chemical weapon’s damage at the start of each of its turns, with no save to avoid it and no cover that helps. The area is not hazardous ground and cannot be moved, expanded or extinguished. It simply is the room now.

cinderfall.incomplete: an automatic no-save recurring AoE damage effect targeting other creatures is, in principle, the kind of thing a real Aura rule element with a linked damage-dealing Effect item *can* express (bestiary auras do this), but I found no exact matching player-feat precedent for a variable-damage-type ("your chemical weapon's damage") recurring aura within this pass's time budget — defaulting to INCOMPLETE per the discipline of not assuming an unfound precedent, flagged for a follow-up search. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
